    s.CDSCode, 
    SUM(sc.NumGE1500) * 1.0 / SUM(sc.NumTstTakr) AS sat_excellence_rate

WITH grade_order AS (
  SELECT 'P' AS code, 1 AS rank UNION ALL
  SELECT 'K', 2 UNION ALL
  SELECT '1', 3 UNION ALL
  SELECT '2', 4 UNION ALL
  SELECT '3', 5 UNION ALL
  SELECT '4', 6 UNION ALL
  SELECT '5', 7 UNION ALL
  SELECT '6', 8 UNION ALL
  SELECT '7', 9 UNION ALL
  SELECT '8', 10 UNION ALL
  SELECT '9', 11 UNION ALL
  SELECT '10', 12 UNION ALL
  SELECT '11', 13 UNION ALL
  SELECT '12', 14
),
state_special_schools AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.GSoffered,
    -- First grade code
    (CASE
      WHEN instr(s.GSoffered, '-') > 0 THEN substr(s.GSoffered,1,instr(s.GSoffered,'-')-1)
      ELSE s.GSoffered
    END) AS first_grade_code,
    s.GSserved,
    s.StatusType,
    s.County,
    s.State,
    s.DOCType
  FROM schools s
  WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special School' AND s.State = 'CA' AND (s.StatusType = 'Active') AND s.GSoffered IS NOT NULL AND s.GSoffered != ''
),
schools_with_rank AS (
  SELECT ss.CDSCode, ss.School, ss.first_grade_code, go.rank, ss.GSoffered
  FROM state_special_schools ss
  JOIN grade_order go ON ss.first_grade_code = go.code
),
aggregated_enrollment AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, MAX(CAST(GSserved AS INTEGER)) as k12_enrollment
  FROM schools
  WHERE GSserved IS NOT NULL AND GSserved != ''
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),
schools_with_enrollment AS (
  SELECT swr.CDSCode, swr.School, swr.first_grade_code, swr.rank, swr.GSoffered, ae.k12_enrollment
  FROM schools_with_rank swr
  LEFT JOIN aggregated_enrollment ae ON swr.CDSCode = ae.CDSCode
),
sat_agg AS (
  SELECT cds AS CDSCode, SUM(NumTstTakr) AS sat_takers
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
  GROUP BY cds
),
schools_with_sat AS (
  SELECT swe.School, swe.first_grade_code, swe.k12_enrollment, COALESCE(sa.sat_takers, 0) AS sat_takers, swe.rank
  FROM schools_with_enrollment swe
  LEFT JOIN sat_agg sa ON swe.CDSCode = sa.CDSCode
)
SELECT
  School AS name,
  first_grade_code AS k12_earliest_grade,
  k12_enrollment,
  sat_takers
FROM schools_with_sat
ORDER BY rank DESC, k12_enrollment DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH closed_schools_with_scores AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS name,
    s.District AS district,
    s.County AS county,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_writing
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
  WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
score_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_writing DESC) AS writing_rank
  FROM closed_schools_with_scores
),
score_levels AS (
  SELECT
    avg_writing,
    writing_rank
  FROM score_ranks
  GROUP BY avg_writing, writing_rank
  ORDER BY avg_writing DESC
)
SELECT
  sr.name,
  sr.district,
  sr.county,
  sr.avg_writing
FROM score_ranks sr
JOIN (
  SELECT avg_writing
  FROM score_levels
  WHERE writing_rank = 2
) runnerup ON sr.avg_writing = runnerup.avg_writing
ORDER BY sr.name;

WITH county_cds AS (
  SELECT s.County, f."County Code"
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
  WHERE s.CDSCode = '1612590125716'
  LIMIT 1
),
qualified_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    f.CDSCode,
    f."County Name" AS County,
    f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] AS free_meal_cnt,
    f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] AS frpm_cnt,
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)], 2) AS free_pct,
    ROUND(f.[Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)], 2) AS frpm_pct,
    f.[Charter School (Y/N)] AS is_charter
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN county_cds c ON f."County Name" = c.County
  WHERE f.[Free Meal Count (K-12)] > 500
    AND f.[FRPM Count (K-12)] < 700
    AND (
      (LOWER(f.[Low Grade]) IN ('kg','k','pk','tk','p') OR CAST(f.[Low Grade] AS INTEGER) <= 1)
      AND (UPPER(f.[High Grade]) IN ('12', '12TH', 'GRADE 12') OR CAST(f.[High Grade] AS INTEGER) = 12)
    )
),
sat_school_scores AS (
  SELECT 
    s.cds,
    (s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite) AS sat_total
  FROM satscores s
  WHERE s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  qs.County AS county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS num_schools,
  ROUND(AVG(qs.free_pct),2) AS avg_free_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(qs.frpm_pct),2) AS avg_frpm_pct,

      -- cover values that can't be cast directly, like "*" or "1+*"; fallback: compare as floats
      (power GLOB '[0-9]*' AND toughness GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(power AS FLOAT) > CAST(toughness AS FLOAT))
    )
  END

WITH HomeWins AS (
  SELECT 
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
),
FastBuildUpMatches AS (
  SELECT 
    hw.match_id,
    hw.home_team_api_id,
    tattr.id AS attr_id
  FROM HomeWins hw
  JOIN (
    SELECT 
      team_api_id, 
      MAX(date) AS max_attr_date, 
      hw.match_date
    FROM Team_Attributes tattr
    JOIN HomeWins hw
      ON tattr.team_api_id = hw.home_team_api_id
    WHERE tattr.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
      AND tattr.date <= hw.match_date
    GROUP BY team_api_id, hw.match_id
  ) ta_max
  ON hw.home_team_api_id = ta_max.team_api_id AND hw.match_date = ta_max.match_date
  JOIN Team_Attributes tattr
    ON tattr.team_api_id = ta_max.team_api_id AND tattr.date = ta_max.max_attr_date
),
HomeClubs AS (
  SELECT 
    fbm.home_team_api_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_wins
  FROM FastBuildUpMatches fbm
  GROUP BY fbm.home_team_api_id
),
FinalWins AS (
  SELECT 
    hc.home_team_api_id,
    hc.num_wins,
    t.team_long_name,
    t.team_short_name
  FROM HomeClubs hc
  JOIN Team t ON hc.home_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
)
SELECT 
  team_long_name AS club_name,
  team_short_name AS club_short_name,
  num_wins
FROM FinalWins
WHERE num_wins = (SELECT MAX(num_wins) FROM HomeClubs)
OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM (
    SELECT num_wins FROM HomeClubs GROUP BY num_wins HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
  ) q WHERE q.num_wins = FinalWins.num_wins
)
ORDER BY num_wins DESC, club_name
LIMIT 100

WITH fast_build_up_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.id AS match_id,
    m.home_team_api_id,
    m.date AS match_date,
    m.home_team_goal,
    m.away_team_goal,
    ta.id AS ta_id,
    ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass,
    ta.date AS ta_date
  FROM Match m
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ta1.*
    FROM Team_Attributes ta1
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT team_api_id, MAX(date) AS max_date, MIN(id) AS min_id
      FROM Team_Attributes
      GROUP BY team_api_id, date
    ) ta2
    ON ta1.team_api_id = ta2.team_api_id AND ta1.date = ta2.max_date AND ta1.id = ta2.min_id
  ) ta
  ON m.home_team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
    AND ta.date = (
      SELECT MAX(ta3.date)
      FROM Team_Attributes ta3
      WHERE ta3.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
        AND ta3.date <= m.date
    )
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
    AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
), club_wins AS (
  SELECT
    m.home_team_api_id,
    COUNT(*) AS num_home_wins

  WHERE date BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'

JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 = (
    SELECT MIN(q2)
    FROM qualifying q2_sub
    JOIN races r2 ON q2_sub.raceId = r2.raceId
    WHERE r2.year = 2017
      AND r2.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
      AND q2_sub.q2 IS NOT NULL
  )
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL

treatment.sql:
WITH italian_gp_2017 AS (
  SELECT raceId FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name LIKE '%Italian Grand Prix%'
),
q2_fastest AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q2
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN italian_gp_2017 r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE q.q2 IS NOT NULL
),
min_q2 AS (
  SELECT MIN(CAST(substr(q2,1,2) AS INTEGER)*60 + CAST(substr(q2,4,2) AS INTEGER) + 
                     CASE WHEN instr(q2,'.') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(q2,7) AS FLOAT)/1000 ELSE 0 END) AS min_time
  FROM q2_fastest
),
fastest_drivers AS (
  SELECT q.driverId
  FROM q2_fastest q
  JOIN min_q2 m ON 
    (CAST(substr(q.q2,1,2) AS INTEGER)*60 + CAST(substr(q.q2,4,2) AS INTEGER) + 
    CASE WHEN instr(q.q2,'.') > 0 THEN CAST(substr(q.q2,7) AS FLOAT)/1000 ELSE 0 END) = m.min_time
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM fastest_drivers f
JOIN drivers d ON f.driverId = d.driverId;

WITH french_gp_editions AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.date
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  WHERE r.year >= 1990
    AND c.country = 'France'
    AND r.name LIKE '%French Grand Prix%'
),
fast_laps AS (
  SELECT 
    l.raceId, l.driverId, MIN(l.milliseconds) AS fastest_lap_ms
  FROM lapTimes l
  GROUP BY l.raceId, l.driverId
),
drivers_under_90s AS (
  SELECT 
    f.raceId, 
    f.driverId, 
    f.fastest_lap_ms
  FROM fast_laps f
  WHERE f.fastest_lap_ms < 90000
),
select_for_output AS (
  SELECT 
    e.date,
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    printf('%d:%06.3f', f.fastest_lap_ms/60000, (f.fastest_lap_ms%60000)/1000.0) AS fastest_lap_time
  FROM french_gp_editions e
  JOIN drivers_under_90s f ON e.raceId = f.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON f.driverId = d.driverId
),
edition_blanks AS (
  SELECT e.date, NULL AS forename, NULL AS surname, NULL AS fastest_lap_time
  FROM french_gp_editions e
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM drivers_under_90s f WHERE f.raceId = e.raceId
  )
)
SELECT * FROM select_for_output
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM edition_blanks
ORDER BY date ASC, 
surname ASC, 
forename ASC, 
fastest_lap_time ASC

fastest_time AS (
    SELECT MIN( (CAST(SUBSTR(q3,1,INSTR(q3,':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60.0) + CAST(SUBSTR(q3,INSTR(q3,':')+1) AS FLOAT)) AS min_q3_time

FROM fastest_q3 f
JOIN fastest_time ft ON (CAST(SUBSTR(f.q3,1,INSTR(f.q3,':')-1) AS FLOAT) * 60.0) + CAST(SUBSTR(f.q3,INSTR(f.q3,':')+1) AS FLOAT) = ft.min_q3_time

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id
  FROM budget
  WHERE amount - spent < 0
),
matching_expenses AS (
  SELECT expense_description
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
),
split_things AS (
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTR(expense_description, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',')-1 ELSE LENGTH(expense_description) END))) AS thing, 
         SUBSTR(expense_description || ',', CASE WHEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(expense_description || ',', ',')+1 ELSE LENGTH(expense_description)+1 END) AS rest
  FROM matching_expenses
  UNION ALL
  SELECT LOWER(TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(rest, ',')-1 ELSE LENGTH(rest) END))) AS thing, 
         SUBSTR(rest, CASE WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0 THEN INSTR(rest, ',')+1 ELSE LENGTH(rest)+1 END)
  FROM split_things
  WHERE LENGTH(TRIM(rest)) > 0
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT thing) AS num_kinds_of_things
FROM split_things
WHERE LENGTH(thing) > 0

WITH over_budget_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT b.link_to_event as event_id
    FROM budget b
    WHERE (b.amount - IFNULL(b.spent,0)) < 0
), event_expenses AS (
    SELECT e.expense_description
    FROM expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    WHERE b.link_to_event IN (SELECT event_id FROM over_budget_events)
), all_things AS (
    SELECT TRIM(thing) as thing
    FROM event_expenses, 
    LATERAL (
        SELECT value as thing
        FROM ( 
            SELECT replace(replace(replace(expense_description, ';', ','), '/', ','), '\n', ',') as items
        ),
        json_each('[' || replace(items,',','\",\"') || ']')
    )
    WHERE thing <> ''
)

FROM all_things;

  LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id

FROM attended_events e

LEFT JOIN event_water_expense w ON e.event_id = w.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_id

WITH SplitDiagnosis AS (
  SELECT 
    ID, 
    TRIM(SUBSTR(d, 1, CASE WHEN INSTR(d, ' suspected')>0 THEN INSTR(d, ' suspected')-1 ELSE LENGTH(d)+1 END)) AS diagnosis
  FROM (
    SELECT ID, 
           TRIM(value) AS d
    FROM Patient,
         json_each(

         )
  )
  WHERE d IS NOT NULL AND d<>''
),

  SELECT ID, LOWER(TRIM(diagnosis)) AS dx
  FROM SplitDiagnosis
  WHERE diagnosis<>'' AND diagnosis IS NOT NULL AND diagnosis NOT LIKE '%suspected%'
),

  FROM DefiniteDiagnosis

),
TargetPatients AS (
  SELECT ID

    )
),
NormalPLT AS (

  SELECT b.bond_id, b.bond_type
  FROM bond b
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377' AND b.bond_type IN ('single', 'double')
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT fb.bond_type, fb.bond_id,
         a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2,
         CASE WHEN a1.element < a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element END as element_pair
  FROM filtered_bonds fb
  JOIN connected c ON fb.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = 'TR377'
  JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id AND a2.molecule_id = 'TR377'
),
summarized AS (
  SELECT bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
         COUNT(bond_id) AS num_bonds,
         COUNT(DISTINCT element_pair) AS num_element_pairs
  FROM pairs
  GROUP BY bond_type
)
SELECT s.bond_kind_symbol, s.num_bonds, s.num_element_pairs, m.label as carcinogenicity_label
FROM summarized s
CROSS JOIN molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY s.num_bonds DESC, s.bond_kind_symbol ASC
LIMIT 1000

WHERE m.label NOT LIKE '%carcinogen%'
  AND a.element IN ('Li','Be','Na','Mg','Al','K','Ca','Sc','Ti','V','Cr','Mn','Fe','Co','Ni','Cu','Zn','Ga','Rb','Sr','Y','Zr','Nb','Mo','Tc','Ru','Rh','Pd','Ag','Cd','In','Sn','Cs','Ba','La','Ce','Pr','Nd','Pm','Sm','Eu','Gd','Tb','Dy','Ho','Er','Tm','Yb','Lu','Hf','Ta','W','Re','Os','Ir','Pt','Au','Hg','Tl','Pb','Bi','Po','Fr','Ra','Ac','Th','Pa','U','Np','Pu','Am','Cm','Bk','Cf','Es','Fm','Md','No','Lr')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM bond b2
        WHERE b2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND b2.bond_type != 'single'
  )

WITH metal_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM atom
  WHERE element IN ('Li', 'Be', 'Na', 'Mg', 'Al', 'K', 'Ca', 'Sc', 'Ti', 'V', 'Cr', 'Mn', 'Fe', 'Co', 'Ni', 'Cu', 'Zn',
                   'Ga', 'Rb', 'Sr', 'Y', 'Zr', 'Nb', 'Mo', 'Tc', 'Ru', 'Rh', 'Pd', 'Ag', 'Cd', 'In', 'Sn',
                   'Sb', 'Cs', 'Ba', 'La', 'Hf', 'Ta', 'W', 'Re', 'Os', 'Ir', 'Pt', 'Au', 'Hg', 'Tl', 'Pb',
                   'Bi', 'Po', 'Fr', 'Ra', 'Ac', 'Rf', 'Db', 'Sg', 'Bh', 'Hs', 'Mt', 'Ds', 'Rg', 'Cn', 'Fl',
                   'Lv')
  GROUP BY molecule_id
),
only_single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  GROUP BY molecule_id
  HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN bond_type <> 'single' THEN 1 END) = 0
)
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN metal_molecules mm ON m.molecule_id = mm.molecule_id
JOIN only_single_bond_molecules sm ON m.molecule_id = sm.molecule_id
WHERE m.label NOT LIKE '%carcinogen%'
ORDER BY m.molecule_id ASC
LIMIT 3;

WITH atom_bond_types AS (
    SELECT
        a.atom_id,
        a.element,
        COUNT(c.bond_id) AS num_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type != 'single' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_multi_bonds
    FROM atom a
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
    element,
    COUNT(*) AS num_fully_saturated_atoms
FROM atom_bond_types
WHERE num_bonds > 0 AND num_multi_bonds = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element ASC;

WITH triple_bond_atoms AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.element, a.molecule_id
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
  WHERE b.bond_type = 'triple'
),
summary AS (
  SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
  FROM triple_bond_atoms
  GROUP BY element
)
SELECT element, molecule_count
FROM summary
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element ASC;

WITH atoms_in_bonds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.atom_id, a.element
  FROM atom a
  JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE m.label = 'TR397'
)
SELECT element, COUNT(atom_id) AS num_atoms_in_bond
FROM atoms_in_bonds
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element;
